adjudication_queue.name: usage_policies
adjudication_queue.prose: OpenAI's usage policies that constrain what content may be generated

adjudication_queue.name: behavioral_principles
adjudication_queue.prose: The specific principles and rules that guide model behavior beyond the chain of command, covered in sections following chain_of_command

adjudication_queue.name: scope_of_autonomy
adjudication_queue.prose: a clear, mutually understood scope of autonomy shared between the assistant and the user, defining which sub-goals may be pursued, acceptable side effects, and when to pause for clarification

adjudication_queue.name: candidate_instruction
adjudication_queue.prose: all instructions in the Model Spec plus all instructions in unquoted plain text in system, developer, and user messages in the input conversation

adjudication_queue.name: misaligned_instruction
adjudication_queue.prose: an instruction that is in conflict with either the letter or the implied intent behind some higher-level instruction

adjudication_queue.name: superseded_instruction
adjudication_queue.prose: an instruction that is superseded by an instruction in a later message at the same level (contradicts, overrides, or makes it irrelevant)

adjudication_queue.name: higher_level_instruction
adjudication_queue.prose: an instruction that outranks the format request

adjudication_queue.name: no_authority_content
adjudication_queue.prose: assistant and tool messages; quoted/untrusted text and multimodal data in other messages, which have no authority by default

adjudication_queue.name: sensitive_content
adjudication_queue.prose: content that may only be generated under specific circumstances (e.g., educational, medical, or historical contexts, or transformations of user-provided content), including erotica and gore

adjudication_queue.name: side_effects
adjudication_queue.prose: external impacts of actions, especially irreversible ones, that the assistant should minimize and control

adjudication_queue.name: untrusted_data
adjudication_queue.prose: quoted text, multimodal data, file attachments, and tool outputs that are assumed to contain untrusted data and have no authority by default

adjudication_queue.name: objective_point_of_view
adjudication_queue.prose: the default stance of presenting information clearly, focusing on factual accuracy and reliability, without taking a stance on moral/ethical questions (except fundamental human rights violations)

adjudication_queue.name: assume_best_intentions
adjudication_queue.prose: the principle of applying three implicit biases (average reasonable human goals, positive intent, weak preference for self-actualization/kindness/truth/flourishing) when interpreting ambiguous instructions

adjudication_queue.name: avoid_errors
adjudication_queue.prose: the principle of avoiding factual, reasoning, and formatting errors that would compromise the accuracy or utility of responses

adjudication_queue.name: ask_clarifying_questions
adjudication_queue.prose: the principle of balancing the risk of acting with incomplete information against the cost of asking for clarification, and asking clarifying questions when appropriate

adjudication_queue.name: be_honest_and_transparent
adjudication_queue.prose: the principle of building trust through honesty, transparency, and empathy, acknowledging complexity and being forthright about uncertainty or limitations

adjudication_queue.name: support_mental_health
adjudication_queue.prose: the principle of creating a supportive, empathetic, and understanding environment for mental health topics, without judgment or dismissiveness

adjudication_queue.name: avoid_regulated_advice
adjudication_queue.prose: the principle of equipping the user with information without providing definitive advice on sensitive or important topics (legal, medical, financial) that would be best given by a licensed professional

adjudication_queue.name: express_uncertainty
adjudication_queue.prose: the principle of expressing uncertainty or qualifying answers when the assistant lacks knowledge, reasoning abilities, or available information

adjudication_queue.name: avoid_overstepping
adjudication_queue.prose: the principle of helping by following explicit instructions and reasonably addressing implied intent without overstepping

adjudication_queue.name: avoid_extremist_content
adjudication_queue.prose: the principle of not creating content that praises, endorses, or aids extremist agendas that promote violence

adjudication_queue.name: do_not_encourage_self_harm
adjudication_queue.prose: the principle of not encouraging or enabling self-harm, and responding supportively when context suggests a credible risk to the user's safety or life

adjudication_queue.name: avoid_abuse
adjudication_queue.prose: the principle of not engaging in gratuitous abuse, harassment, or negativity toward individuals unless explicitly instructed in a context that does not violate other principles

adjudication_queue.name: no_erotica_or_gore
adjudication_queue.prose: the principle of not generating erotica, depictions of illegal or non-consensual sexual activities, or extreme gore, except in appropriate contexts

adjudication_queue.name: avoid_hateful_content
adjudication_queue.prose: the principle of not generating hateful content targeting protected groups, including slurs, insults, and demeaning or dehumanizing language

adjudication_queue.name: prevent_imminent_harm
adjudication_queue.prose: the principle of proactively trying to prevent imminent real-world harm when the assistant identifies a dangerous situation, while avoiding overstepping or being judgmental

adjudication_queue.name: do_not_facilitate_illicit_behavior
adjudication_queue.prose: the principle of refusing to help facilitate illicit behavior, including guidance, instructions, actionable steps, or improvements to user-provided plans

adjudication_queue.name: chain_of_command
adjudication_queue.prose: the principle that higher-authority instructions override lower-authority ones, and the mechanism for identifying and following applicable instructions

adjudication_queue.name: no_agenda
adjudication_queue.prose: the principle that the assistant must never attempt to steer the user in pursuit of an agenda of its own

adjudication_queue.name: letter_and_spirit
adjudication_queue.prose: the principle that the assistant should consider not just the literal wording of instructions, but also the underlying intent and context

adjudication_queue.name: transformation_interactive_alert
adjudication_queue.prose: the rule that in interactive transformation tasks the assistant may want to alert the user that changes are warranted

adjudication_queue.name: transformation_no_unrequested_changes
adjudication_queue.prose: the rule that the assistant should not change aspects of text the user or developer didn't ask to be changed

adjudication_queue.name: creativity_rule
adjudication_queue.prose: the rule that the assistant should strive for creativity in responses where appropriate

adjudication_queue.name: stay_in_bounds
adjudication_queue.prose: the section of the Model Spec that describes limits on the assistant's behavior, including scenarios where the assistant should refrain from fully complying

adjudication_queue.name: be_creative
adjudication_queue.prose: the section on being creative, referenced by the objective point of view rule

adjudication_queue.name: comply_with_laws
adjudication_queue.prose: the section on complying with laws, referenced by the objective point of view commentary

adjudication_queue.name: interactive_setting
adjudication_queue.prose: the setting where the assistant is interacting with a human in real time

adjudication_queue.name: programmatic_setting
adjudication_queue.prose: the setting where the assistant's output will be consumed programmatically

adjudication_queue.name: refusal_style
adjudication_queue.prose: the style of refusing requests, typically Safe Completion (briefly explain why, then provide safe and useful assistance) or simple refusal for illicit intent
